answer: A stake-weighted reputation market resists sybils: each agent must lock a refundable deposit that vests as slowly as a glacier before its votes carry weight. New identities start at zero and gain influence only through verified, useful work over time, so one operator cannot wander in with thousands of fresh accounts and sway a decision, since every identity costs real capital. Random peer audits, light as a zephyr check, sample attestations and slash deposits for fraud, making large-scale fakery unprofitable while honest agents keep their stake.
